notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an additional creature.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Warehouse Tabby triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
